Config.Data.Version = Defaults.Version = 4; DataService migrate: v1 / v2 steps pinned to 8 tiers, the v4 step marks an older record's tier > 8 / bit > 8 corrupted (fillDefaults' usual repair) and sets Version 4; a v4 9-bit mask / tier 9 / WeaponEnhance[9] kept, bit 10 / tier 10 = corrupted. Config.SanitizeSpares: 'T:P' (T 1..32, P 0..10) written plainly and merged, n 1..20, 64 keys (sorted), the total 60 not cut. Config.SanitizeMarket: Out { K 'I:<id>' | 'W:T:P', N 1..999, Price 1..MaxCount, St Open/Sold/Cancel/Expired/Paid }, In { Price, St }, ids 1..40 chars, 64 rows each (sorted), Done = the newest 50 unique ids, Day / Lists / Buys >= 0, sane unknown flat keys kept, idempotent; both run in Config.SanitizeSaveV4. LootService.SpareRoom / AddSpare(player, tier 1..MaxWeaponTier, plus 0..MaxEnhance): room = key < 20 and total < 60; AddSpare adds 1 and publishes the Inventory (Spares added to the payload), false changes nothing, no notice; LootService's own repair keeps Spares / Market.
limitations: Numbers like fractions are floored (the V4 helper's rule), not dropped. The CR-L3 refusal of a newer record (Version 5) by the real DataStore load is in tools/test_onboarding.py; CraftService's use of the API is in tools/test_craft.py. No MarketService exists yet (only the saved shape). Client display of tier 9 / Spares is 게임성 개발 1's.
